title: Infinite Yous: rough cut
heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ Infinite Yous
intro: Rough cut 4 (Jack: "use the white lines from the first video as a reference for BadCode to close; remove the other thing" + voice note "make them English, say this line fast"): the squeeze is remade from the split frame itself, gripping and closing the thin white lines (no metal bars); the figure's line is a fast English take (London) as a stand-in; the lad's line is louder over the music.

flags: Lad: Jack's pick a (Puck), a brisk retake fitted to the talking clip at x1.20 ("home" lands 0.12 s after his lips close). Figure: round-3 take h (English, fast) as a stand-in until Jack picks.
WL2-b (1 s, mid-squeeze): the light-lines cover the mask, so the triangle is hidden.

items: The squeeze: three new stills made from the split frame: WL1r-b grips the white lines (6.5), WL2-b crushes the five into a blazing seam (7.5), a white flash into WL3-a, one dazed lad (8.5). No metal bars.
Figure voice: round 3, English and fast: g Oxford, h London (in the cut), i Birmingham, on the voice page.
